name: agent-auditor
description: Independent coding-agent audit: signatures + your separate Auditor AI API (local-first)

commands.title: Agent Auditor: Connect Model (chọn hãng + API key)

agentAuditor.privacy.description: Local only (recommended). Share anonymous signatures is a stub — nothing is uploaded in V1.

agentAuditor.mode.description: Observe (rules only), Audit (calls your separate Auditor AI), Guard (pause stub).

agentAuditor.eventsFile.description: Workspace-relative JSONL event stream to watch.

agentAuditor.guardPause.description: Opt-in Guard pause recommendation stub (never kills the agent).

agentAuditor.llmEnabled.description: Call Auditor AI when interpreting signatures (requires allowNetworkAi + Global settings).

agentAuditor.autoDiscover.description: Also ingest newest *.jsonl under known agent folders (.cursor, .claude, .aider, .continue, .windsurf, .cline, …). Prompts/CoT are dropped. Canonical feed remains .auditor/events.jsonl.

agentAuditor.autoStart.description: Start watching automatically when a workspace opens. Tracks file saves/errors as behavioral signatures only (no code, prompt, or CoT).

agentAuditor.allowNetworkAi.description: Explicitly allow network calls to the Auditor AI provider. Independent of privacy=local_only (pattern telemetry).

agentAuditor.llmProvider.description: Independent Auditor AI provider — Global/User only (workspace overrides ignored for API calls).

agentAuditor.llmModel.description: Model id for the Auditor AI (Global/User).

agentAuditor.llmBaseUrl.description: Optional base URL (Global/User only; allowlisted hosts unless custom confirmed).

agentAuditor.apiKey.description: Legacy fallback. Prefer Agent Auditor: Connect Model (choose provider, then paste key).

scripts.package: pnpm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository -o agent-auditor-0.1.1.vsix
